title: Constructible cohomological intervals
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\Ql$, an integer $n\in\mathbf
Z_{\geq1}$, and a scheme $Y$ on which $\ell$ is invertible, as well as
integers $a,b\in\mathbf Z$ with $a\leq b$. Put $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n\mathcal O_E$ with the coefficient convention [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and use the
derived cohomology sheaves [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves] $\mathcal
H^r$. Define

$$
D_c^{[a,b]}(Y,A)=
\{K\in D^b_c(Y,A):
\mathcal H^r(K)=0\text{ for every }
r\in\mathbf Z\setminus[a,b]\}.
$$

Here $D^b_c(Y,A)$ is the bounded category with the finite-torsion
constructibility condition [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility].

The interval is the inclusive integer interval $[a,b]=\{r\in\mathbf Z:a\leq r\leq b\}$. Thus the displayed vanishing condition is cohomological amplitude in $[a,b]$ [def-weil-derived-category-cohomological-support]. We regard $D_c^{[a,b]}(Y,A)$ as the full subcategory on these objects [def-sf-induced-category]: for any two such objects $K,L$ its morphisms are exactly $\operatorname{Hom}_{D^b_c(Y,A)}(K,L)$, with the inherited identities and composition.
